# Canonical integration path: extend kernel `main` through `egregore/` (PR #160 lineage), compose the existing control plane, and credit the draft lineages through adapters and lineage records

## Decision

Build on kernel **main (19fa33c)** by extending the `egregore/` package with ledger-backed goal structures, exactly the shape already present on `claude/goal-gravity-loop-20261013` (ef4f5c7, draft PR #160, one commit ahead of main). Do **not** build on PR #158, #114/#137 or #93/#97/#109. Treat PR #160 as the candidate implementation of this path, with the residual deficits listed below as the work that remains before it is honestly "extending the canonical architecture" rather than "a sibling loop in the canonical package".
